description: Determine everything affected by major life changes.
notes: Kit fallback at ../kit-fallback-w9.js; Texas move has full 31 items/8 categories per demo spec

notes.note: 'The checklist people forward to friends' is exactly right — life-change checklists are inherently viral. But virality isn't revenue: the free checklist is the product and the $12/mo Plus is a weak upsell. The B2B relocation/HR path is the business; the consumer app is the marketing.

notes.change: dependency graph (8 nodes wide) was squeezed to ~40% scale in its column; made the graph host horizontally scrollable with a 1150px minimum svg width

graph nodes were invisible (shared kit sets border-color on SVG rects, which is a no-op; fill matched the card); promoted each node's color to a real SVG stroke, and gave the graph host horizontal scroll at 1150px min-width (was squeezed to ~40% scale)

notes.note: Accordion checklist; check-off updates handled counter + persists; zero errors.

notes.change: Checklist header gained 'Copy shareable plan' — one click copies the full household plan grouped by category with live ✓/☐ progress and per-item deadlines (the thesis's 'checklist people forward to friends' loop, README next-3 #3). Life-change buttons got data-core.
